a1.cap: Save '' and the count 3, then start fresh.
Close a group: repeat it 3 times. Text is now 'aaa'.
Save 'aaa' and the count 2, then start fresh.
Close a group: repeat it 2 times. Text is now 'aaabcbc'.
Time complexity is O(output) and extra space is O(n).
